per_turn.message: What does the Generative AI Profile suggest for decommissioning GAI systems?

labels: NIST AI 600-1, §3 Suggested Actions to Manage GAI Risks, GOVERN 1.7, p. 17
NIST AI 600-1, §3 Suggested Actions to Manage GAI Risks, GOVERN 4.1, pp. 18–19

checks.name: link check
checks.detail: 2 cited chunk(s) open the right page

sentences.sentence: The Generative AI Profile recommends that organizations put in place protocols that allow GAI systems to be deactivated when necessary and that, when decommissioning, they consider factors such as data‑retention requirements, data security and leakage, dependencies with other systems, use of open‑source data or models, and users’ emotional entanglement with the GAI functions.

It also advises establishing policies, procedures and oversight functions that span the entire GAI lifecycle, from problem formulation and supply chains to system decommission, to ensure safe and risk‑aware phasing out of GAI systems.
